learning.title: docker compose down -v leaves the worker container and its state volume behind
learning.trigger: Any seat tearing down a per-worktree bakery stack with 'docker compose -p <project> down -v' and considering the teardown complete (night of 2026-11-17: qa-qa leaked qa-510-worker-1 and qa-479-worker-1 plus both _worker-state volumes - down -v removed the postgres service but not the worker service; hit twice in one night).
learning.rule: down -v does not reach the worker service on this stack. The reliable teardown is: docker compose -p <project> down -v, THEN explicitly check for and remove <project>-worker-1 (container) and <project>_worker-state (volume). Every seat that spins a stack runs both steps before reporting cleanup done. Leaks cost host memory under the 25 GB budget across ~11 seats.

verification.requirement: After teardown: 'docker ps -a --filter name=<project>' and 'docker volume ls --filter name=<project>' both return empty before cleanup is reported.
